content: Ravi Menon contacted Meera Chauhan regarding the reinstatement of her cancelled health policy (HP-DC-2024-5678), detailing a total due of ₹14,800 which can be split into two installments of ₹7,400. Ravi provided the reinstatement form and payment link. Meera confirmed she will sign and upload the form and pay the first installment of ₹7,400 today, requesting confirmation upon processing.

action_items: Sign and upload the reinstatement form by the evening
Agent to confirm payment receipt and process policy reinstatement
